name: Scale Plate
description: Raise a flat plate of bone over the chest and set it to take a cut or a thrust.

name: Plate Bash
description: Drive the edge of a forearm plate into the target in a short flat sweeping bash.

name: Edge Roll
description: Angle the rim of the plate so a blade slides off it and away from the body.

name: Plate Shed
description: Let the outer layer of the plate flake off and leave a denser one beneath it.

name: Overlapping Plates
description: Lay plate over plate along the arms and trunk so each layer strengthens the one beneath.

name: Plate Hurl
description: Tear a loose plate from the shoulder and spin it hard at the target's head.

name: Spine Lash
description: Loosen the back into a supple chain and lash its tip across the target's body.

name: Spine Coil
description: Coil the whip of bone round the user in a spring that takes the force of a blow.

name: Whip Count
description: Trail the whip over a surface and count the links that touch to judge its shape.

name: Backbone Draw
description: Draw bone qi up the whole column of the spine to stiffen it for the next lash.

name: Lash Step
description: Plant the whip tip in the ground and pull the body after it in a long low step.

name: Whip Snare
description: Loop the segmented whip round the target's limb and draw it tight until the limb is held.

name: Chaining Spine
description: Snap the whip out in three linked lashes so each follows the last along the same line.

name: Spike Rise
description: Push a long spike of bone out of the forearm and drive it into the target's guard.

name: Spike Shed
description: Flick a small spike free of the arm and throw it a short way at a single foe.

name: Spike Parry
description: Meet a blow with the side of a forearm spike and turn it off its line.

name: Spike Draw
description: Draw the spikes in and out of the skin in a slow rhythm to harden them and warm the arm.

name: Spike Bristle
description: Bristle spikes over the whole back so any grip or tackle lands on points and hurts the one who tries it.

name: Driven Spike
description: Drive a thick spike forward behind the whole weight of the body and through a hardened guard.

name: Skull Cap
description: Thicken the bone of the skull until a blow to the head rings and does not crack it.

name: Head Ram
description: Drive the hardened brow into the target's face or chest in a short straight ram.

name: Brow Turn
description: Roll the head so a strike slides over the curve of the brow and away.

name: Ward Sense
description: Listen with the bones of the skull for the tread and the hum of anyone close behind.

name: Cranial Hum
description: Set the skull humming at a steady pitch that clears the head and steadies the aim.

name: Jaw Clamp
description: Clamp the jaw hard on the target's sleeve or hand and wrench it from its line.

name: Helm Grow
description: Grow a ridged helm of bone over the head and neck that turns blows and steadies the stance.

name: Ram Rush
description: Rush low behind the helm and knock the target off balance with the crown of the head.

name: Marrow Rush
description: Send a rush of qi up the arm bone and let the blow break with the heat of the marrow.

name: Surge Ward
description: Let a surge of qi rise through the bones to stiffen them just before a blow lands.

name: Marrow Read
description: Feel the pulse of qi in the marrow of another and judge how full their reserve stands.

name: Rising Marrow
description: Raise warmth through the long bones one after another until the whole frame is quickened.

name: Marrow Step
description: Spring off the heel on a pulse of qi that runs down the thigh and shin.

name: Marrow Flood
description: Flood an ally's bones with warm qi to close small breaks and chips and ease deep ache.

name: Surge Wave
description: Stamp so the surge runs out of the legs in a wave that jars the footing of every foe near.
